method: ffmpeg samples one frame per wall second from the continuous 2,288.4-second WebM and tiles up to 16 frames per image; no game state or render edits

filmstrips.name: rear service vault and ensuing aimed fight
filmstrips.observation: Mara rises over and lands beyond the service barrier, then aims and fires while the live objective, rain and HUD continue.

filmstrips.name: yard van passenger entry and extraction
filmstrips.observation: Mara reaches the yard van; entry and passenger seating lead into physical movement through the depot yard without a visible position jump in these sampled frames.

filmstrips.name: garage boarding and drive-through departure
filmstrips.observation: Mara and Jun approach and board the repaired van, and it moves across the marked garage bay under ordinary input.

limits: One-frame-per-second contact sheets do not establish every transition frame or subjective animation polish.
The full silent WebM is retained outside the repository; this evidence cannot substitute for headphone/speaker audio listening.
Software-rendered WSL video cadence is not the named-hardware frame-rate baseline.
